usage: agentware query [-h] [--format {text,json}] (--id ID | --path PATH |
                       --category CATEGORY | --tag TAG |
                       --depends-on DEPENDS_ON | --impact IMPACT |
                       --relates RELATES) [--depth DEPTH]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --id ID               look up a single entry by id
  --path PATH           look up a single entry by path
  --category CATEGORY   list all entries in a category
  --tag TAG             list all entries carrying a tag
  --depends-on DEPENDS_ON
                        forward closure: entries the given id depends on
  --impact IMPACT       reverse closure: entries that depend on the given id
  --relates RELATES     direct graph neighbors of the given id (both
                        directions)
  --depth DEPTH         traversal hops for graph queries (default 1; 0 = full
                        closure)
